profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Engineer | React & Typescript
profile.summary: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building production React and TypeScript applications for a live e-commerce platform. Leads engineering and UX initiatives alongside a junior developer and serves as the primary intake point between executive leadership and engineering, turning product requests into clear technical plans and shipped features. Expertise in component-driven frontend architecture, reusable UI patterns, and design-system thinking, with hands-on experience in REST/GraphQL API integration, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and production ownership from design through release. Applying AI-assisted engineering techniques via agentic coding with Codex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), sub-agent orchestration, and multi-agent/mixture-of-experts patterns to improve development workflows and help teams adopt modern AI-enabled engineering practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead engineering delivery alongside a junior software engineer, owning end-to-end development of a production e-commerce platform across React/TypeScript frontend, backend/service integrations, and business-critical application logic.
• Serve as the primary intake point between executive leadership and the engineering team, sitting in stakeholder meetings and translating high-level product asks into technical requirements, implementation plans, and production releases.
• Establish engineering standards for accessibility, performance, reliability, and frontend architecture that the rest of the team follows, while serving as the primary technical resource for the team.
• Identify technical dependencies, implementation risks, and ambiguous requirements early, working with leadership and design to align on scope before development begins.
• Mentor a junior software engineer from onboarding through independent ownership, covering architecture, implementation, debugging, QA, and Git/GitHub workflows to the point where they now handle production deployments independently.
• Build and maintain API-driven features using REST APIs, GraphQL, and third-party service integrations to support checkout, promotions, shipping incentives, discount rules, eligibility logic, and custom bundle/pack functionality.
• Own feature delivery from design through production across navigation, landing pages, product collections, cart, checkout, and promotional experiences.
• Serve as the main escalation point for high-impact production issues, diagnosing root causes across services, integrations, and revenue-critical systems.
• Support development and release workflows through GitHub Actions.
• Exploring AI-assisted engineering practices such as Codex-based agentic coding, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations, sub-agent workflows, agents.md conventions, and multi-agent/mixture-of-experts orchestration concepts to evaluate for team adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized a modern React and TypeScript web application, building reusable, component-based UI patterns to deliver responsive, high-performance experiences across desktop and mobile.
• Integrated and maintained third-party APIs and services across analytics, reviews/UGC, retention, loyalty, search, and customer experience tools.
• Drove CRO experimentation and A/B testing  building test variations, implementing tracking, monitoring KPIs, and rolling out winning experiences based on data.
• Supported QA, performance audits, and accessibility improvements, and led release testing to improve stability, usability, and overall site performance.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to a platform modernization from a template-based storefront to a component-based React architecture, helping rebuild core frontend and backend functionality for improved maintainability and performance.
• Supported daily web and mobile development operations, including QA, bug fixes, content updates, third-party tool setup, and ongoing performance optimization.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the lead instructor to teach web development fundamentals, focusing on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Git/GitHub version control.
- Conducted code reviews and provided constructive feedback to help students improve code quality, readability, and best practices.
- Guided students in understanding core coding principles by offering clear explanations, real-world examples, and one-on-one support during labs and projects.
